formats.why_en: 'What if' videos create an instant curiosity gap and are evergreen: they keep getting search + suggested traffic for years.
formats.why_sr: 'Šta ako' video odmah stvara radoznalost i ne zastareva - dobija pretragu i preporuke godinama.
formats.thumb: GLAVONJA shocked in the foreground, the impossible situation huge behind him, 2-3 word text.

formats.why_en: Survival challenges ('Could you survive...') put the viewer in the character's shoes; high retention because the outcome is unknown.
formats.why_sr: Izazovi preživljavanja stavljaju gledaoca u kožu lika; visoko zadržavanje jer je ishod neizvestan.
formats.thumb: GLAVONJA in danger (scared face), the threat close behind, red arrow, text like 'DAY 1'.

formats.why_en: Historical mysteries mix education with storytelling; strong for long watch time and older audiences.
formats.why_sr: Istorijske misterije spajaju edukaciju i priču; jako dobre za dugo gledanje.
formats.thumb: GLAVONJA as an explorer in front of an ancient object with a big question mark.

formats.why_en: Horror stories have very high retention and comment activity; stickman style keeps them watchable for all ages.
formats.why_sr: Horor priče imaju veoma visoko zadržavanje i mnogo komentara; stickman stil ih čini prijatnim za sve uzraste.
formats.thumb: Dark background, GLAVONJA terrified, glowing eyes in the darkness, 2-word text.

formats.why_en: Fast fact lists are easy to produce in volume and work well as Shorts spin-offs.
formats.why_sr: Brze liste činjenica se lako prave u većem broju i dobre su za Shorts.
formats.thumb: GLAVONJA with mind-blown expression, the strangest fact as an image, number in the corner.

formats.why_en: Extreme scale comparisons and challenges ('1 vs 100', 'every level of...') are very clickable and easy to visualise.
formats.why_sr: Ekstremna poređenja i izazovi su veoma klikabilni i laki za vizualizaciju.
formats.thumb: Tiny GLAVONJA next to something gigantic, arrow and number.

formats.why_en: Explainers answer real search questions; good for discoverability.
formats.why_sr: Objašnjenja odgovaraju na stvarne pretrage; dobra za otkrivanje kanala.
formats.thumb: GLAVONJA pointing at the subject, question mark, short text.
